name: Sentinel
description: Southern highbush blueberry cultivar Sentinel ('FL11-155') from the University of Florida IFAS breeding programme, released 2020. Commercialisation rights administered by Florida Foundation Seed Producers, Inc.

traits.value: UF/IFAS published firmness of 237 at harvest and 226 after 21 days, average 237 g/mm
traits.conditions: UF/IFAS blueberry breeding programme measurements, Florida
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS blueberry breeding programme

traits.value: UF/IFAS published average berry weight 2.2 g (range 1.9-3.0) and average diameter 17.2 mm (range 15.9-19.6)
traits.conditions: UF/IFAS blueberry breeding programme measurements, Florida
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS blueberry breeding programme

traits.value: UF/IFAS published soluble solids of average 11.1 (range 9.3-12.7); Brix/acid ratio average 30.67
traits.conditions: UF/IFAS blueberry breeding programme measurements, Florida
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS blueberry breeding programme

traits.value: UF sensory flavour score of 27.5, against 19.9 for Emerald and 29.2 for Kestrel
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS blueberry breeding programme

traits.value: UF/IFAS measured an average of 16.4 lb per plant (range 8.8-21.0) in north-central Florida across 2018-2020, and 8.2 lb per plant (range 5.6-10.9) in central Florida
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS blueberry breeding programme

traits.value: Conflicting statements: the UF breeding programme page records 'no data yet', while UF/IFAS extension publication HS1245 describes the cultivar as suitable for machine harvest
traits.asserted_by: University of Florida IFAS (two publications disagree)

attributes.extension_notes: UF/IFAS extension reports it is firmer than Emerald and does not require hydrogen cyanamide.
